restaurantName: No.18 Zion Road Fried Kway Teow
address: Zion Riverside Food Centre, #017, 70 Zion Road, 247792, Singapore
bio: Kway teow noodles are fried to order and topped with fish cake and cockles. The wok hei impresses with its robust flavours and a hint of spiciness, while the cockles impart extra umami. The wait can be long, but is well worth it....
pageTitle: No.18 Zion Road Fried Kway Teow
